title: Runtime audio
responsibility: Plays recorded audio with transcripts and matching before/after clips.

inputs.name: RuntimeAudio.result
inputs.description: Required evidence result with audio entries, declarations, comparison mode and commit scope. Groups clips by comparison identity; after falls back to current.

inputs.name: RuntimeAudio.evidence
inputs.description: Evidence state providing a URL for side and file. Promise failures are caught and shown as unverified.

outputs.name: RuntimeAudio
outputs.description: Audio panel when clips exist or audio is declared. Commit mode pairs before/after; other modes show current. Includes playback controls, transcript when present, standing/status and reading/error states. Missing sides and declared-but-absent clips are explicit gaps.
